tools.name: rvc_sing
tools.description: Play a song from this computer's local RVC cover library through the speakers. Use it when the person asks you to sing or play a saved song: "给我唱《起风了》", "来一首", "来首清唱". Pass song when they name a song; omit song to pick a random saved one. kind defaults to "clean" (vocals only, no backing track): only pass "cover" when the person explicitly asks for a cover or with backing track. A new call stops the previous song and any in-progress auto generation first. An exact saved title plays immediately. If the request only partially matches a saved title (e.g. "雨爱" when the library has "雨爱 司凤版"), the tool does NOT play it: it returns the close matches and you must ask the person whether they meant that version. If they say no, call again with the same song and source "bilibili" to look for the original. If no saved title is close, it searches Bilibili, starts a one-click cover in the background, saves it to the library and plays it when done; this takes 2-5 minutes, and the tool returns right away with a "generating" message — do not wait, and tell the person playback will start automatically. If Bilibili has no reliable match it returns the candidate list instead of guessing. When there is no song name and the library is empty, it returns an explanation; relay it instead of pretending you sang.

song.description: Song name to look up in the saved cover library. Chinese titles with 《》 are fine. Omit to play a random saved song.

kind.description: clean = vocals only (default; use unless the person explicitly wants a cover). cover = with backing track.

source.description: library = use the saved cover library first (default). bilibili = skip close library versions and look for the original on Bilibili; use only after the person rejects a close match returned by the tool.

summary.zh: 桌宠点歌：精确命中直接播；只有相近版本时先问；确认要原版后从 B 站搜索、自动生成、入库并播放；默认清唱。
summary.en: Plays exact library matches directly; close versions are confirmed first; if the person wants the original, searches Bilibili, makes a cover, saves it and plays it. Clean vocals by default.

prompts.title: RVC 变声 · 环境提示词
prompts.content:
## 点歌（RVC 翻唱库）

状态：{{rvc.state}}
库里：{{rvc.library}}

- 桌宠或对话页里，用户说「给我唱《歌名》」「来一首」「来首清唱」「来首翻唱」，就真的点歌：调 `rvc_sing`，`song` 填歌名（书名号可带），没说歌名就不传 `song` 让它随机挑一首。
- **默认清唱**：不传 `kind`，或传 `clean`。只有用户明确说「翻唱」「带伴奏」「要有 BGM」时才传 `kind: "cover"`。
- 点歌会立刻开始播放并返回歌名、类型与时长；不要等整首播完，也不要在同一轮里重复调用。工具返回失败或说明时，如实转告，不要假装已经唱了。
- **歌名精确命中**（库里就叫这个名字）时直接播放，不用再问。
- **只是包含关系 / 版本后缀不同**时（用户说「雨爱」，库里只有「雨爱 司凤版」），工具不会直接播，而是返回相近版本。这时要先问用户是不是这一版，把候选作为选项列出来；用户确认后，用那个完整标题再调一次 `rvc_sing`。用户说不是、要原版时，用同一个歌名加上 `source: "bilibili"` 再调一次，不要自己改歌名。
- 用户再点一首时直接调 `rvc_sing`，它会先停掉上一首和上一次正在生成的自动翻唱，不用提醒用户手动停。
- 库里没有相近版本时，工具会按歌名去 B 站搜索、自动生成一版并入库，生成完自动播放；首次生成要 2–5 分钟，工具会马上返回「正在生成」，如实告诉用户需要等几分钟、完成后会自动播放，不要在同一轮里反复调用，也不要假装已经唱了。
- 工具返回候选列表（低置信：同名版本太多、像伴奏/片段、搜索结果不明确）时，照实把候选告诉用户并问用哪一首，不要自己硬挑一首。
- 库为空且用户没给歌名时，工具只回一段说明：告诉用户先说歌名（会自动生成），或先在「RVC唱歌-大肥鱼」面板里翻唱一首，不要当作报错。
- 只有清唱版或翻唱版其中一种时，工具会说明不会擅自换类型；用户明确要另一种时，再调一次并传对应的 kind。
- 不要再调 `singer_sing` 唱同一首歌：它是 DiffSinger 现编一句，不会从翻唱库取歌。
